_readme: Walkable paths and drivable roads. The roads in this file came from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) — a community base to trace against. Trace more with the in-app draw tool: kind (path | road | steps) and optional surface (paved | unpaved). Routing topology comes from exact coordinate identity: where two lines join, their shared endpoints MUST be the same point, so snap new lines to existing endpoints.
